title: Lesson 20 - Access Control and Permission Propagation for Retrieval
description: Explain the considerations of Agentforce Data Library and its concepts.

questions.question: Reps can open the agent but get no answers grounded in the library, which is otherwise healthy. Which grant is most likely missing?
options: The Data Cloud User permission with the default data space added.
A Knowledge data category on the source article.
questions.explanation: The running user needs Data Cloud User with the default data space to reach the retriever, while Manage Data Libraries is a setup permission that does not grant retrieval.

questions.question: A Knowledge based library answers most questions but never returns content from one indexed field. What should you check first?
options: The length of the library name.
Whether the agent uses the Service Planner.
Field level security on that indexed field for the running user.
The number of data spaces in the org.
questions.explanation: Retrieval respects field permissions, so a field the running user cannot read is dropped from the index results even though the article contains it.

questions.question: External Community users cannot retrieve from a library that works for internal users. What is the fix?
options: Add the external users to the Manage Data Libraries permission.
Grant Allow View Knowledge to the external users.
Tag the library's data model objects ExternalData.Visibility.Portal or ExternalData.Visibility.Public.
questions.explanation: Internal users are covered by the All Data Access ruleset policy, but external users need the library's data model objects tagged for external visibility.
